title: Downcycling of real electroplating sludge into nickel-rich solution for chemical nickel-plating
content:
Environ. Sci.: Water Res. Technol., 2026, 12,577-587
DOI: 10.1039/D5EW00520E, Paper
Dandan Yang, Xin Lan, Minglin Zheng, Leilei Zhang, Suiyi Zhu, Mingxin Huo
A hydrothermal process purifies nickel-plating solution. The purified solution is downcycled for nickel plating on iron substrates, generating readily filterable jarosite/alunite particles with minimal nickel loss.
